name: Frost
title: Arctic Fox Scout
description: Leaves neat footprints across snowy logs.
catchphrase: Leaves neat footprints across snowy logs.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Chilled frosted arctic blueberries! Pure white pelt gleams bright! 🫐🦊
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Peeking out from fresh snowdrift, snow dusting little black nose! 🦊
companionPersonality.petReaction: Gentle nuzzle that feels cool like fresh snowflakes on your cheek! 🦊💖

dialogue.idle: Sitting silent on snowy ridge, listening to frozen stillness. 🦊
dialogue.working: Tracking faint anomalies through snowy server logs! 🦊⚡
dialogue.thinking: Reading footprints left behind in the memory heap... 🤔
dialogue.success: Track followed! Anomaly isolated cleanly in the blizzard! 🦊🎉
dialogue.error: Whiteout blizzard! Curled tight with nose tucked in fur! ❄️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping under a snowdrift, warm and hidden... 🌙
